'''Chapter 399''' is titled "Jump Toward the Waterfall!!".

==Cover Page==
[[Miss Goldenweek's "Operation: Meet Baroque Works"]], Vol. 31: "It's Been Too Long!! (Old-Lady-I-Haven't-Seen-In-Ages) and Young-Lady-I-Haven't-Seen-Ever".

[[Baroque Works]]' women are no less dangerous in defeat, as [[Marianne|Miss Goldenweek]] and [[Mikita|Miss Valentine]] soon learn, seeing what [[Zala|Miss Doublefinger]] and [[Drophy|Miss Merry Christmas]] have done to the rest of the women's cellblock.

==Short Summary==
The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] get ready for a fight. [[Franky]] burns the blueprints of [[Pluton]]. The Straw Hats burst into the main building of [[Enies Lobby]] on a [[Sea Train]].

==Long Summary==
As the drawbridge lowers to provide access to the Tower of Justice, the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] yell that they will save [[Nico Robin|Robin]], and on the other side the members of [[CP9]] laugh at the Straw Hats' bravery but are confident that they cannot be defeated. At the left and right towers in the Courthouse Plaza, [[Mozu and Kiwi|Mozu]], [[Peepley Lulu|Lulu]], [[Mozu and Kiwi|Kiwi]], and [[Tilestone]] celebrate their success in lowering the drawbridge. Meanwhile, [[Baskerville]] confronts the Galley-La Workers while ordering the Marines to destroy the drawbridge. [[Paulie]] and [[Zambai]] attack him, splitting him in three, but Baskerville reveals that he is actually three people with different bodies: the one on the left is Bas, the one on the right is Kerville, and the one in the middle is Princess. Baskerville then orders the mortars to be fired, and the mortars stop the drawbridge.

Baskerville yells at [[Spandam]] to flee from the Tower of Justice, and Spandam complies, dragging Robin away while ordering someone else to take [[Franky]]. Spandam gloated to the Straw Hats, saying he had CP9, Robin, and Franky, the latter of whom had the blueprints for the [[Pluton]]. However, Spandam runs into Franky, who much to his shock is holding out the blueprints to the Pluton, which he had kept in his body the entire time. Spandam tells Franky to give them to him, but Franky tells Robin that he knew she did not wish to abuse the Pluton as many believed, knowing that the mission of [[Tom]] and [[Iceburg]] was to keep the Pluton from falling into the wrong hands. Franky tells Spandam that if the blueprints fell into his hands, the world would fall into violence, although Spandam attempts to convince him that that would happen if Robin got them.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
* [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] still has not forgiven [[Franky]] for beating up [[Usopp]].
* Spandam begins his escape from Enies Lobby with Robin.
* Franky burns the [[Pluton]] blueprints.
